Just morning, and you, and the life that answered."},{"fragmentId":"ar-ab6","text":"You tip well. You book the trip. You breathe. Enough stopped being a ceiling and became a floor: A home by the sea."},{"fragmentId":"se10","text":"Your own handwriting in the margin of today's list looks different lately. Rounder. Strange and wonderful, how the intention held: my own design studio, with clients who trust my eye."},{"fragmentId":"se3","text":"The air outside smells faintly of rain that already fell.
